import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = 1L << 60;
    static long[][] comb = new long[61][61];
    static int R, C;
    static String S;
    static List<long[]>[] dpL = new List[31];
    static List<long[]>[] dpR = new List[31];
    static long ans = 0;

    static void init() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        S = br.readLine();
        
        comb[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 61; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j];
                if (j > 0) comb[i][j] += comb[i-1][j-1];
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
            dpL[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            dpR[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void dfsL(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpL[a].add(new long[]{p, mask});
            return;
        }
        dfsL(ind + 1, a + 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), 
             p + (comb[a + 1][R] - comb[a][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsL(ind + 1, a, b + 1, mask,
             p - (comb[b + 1][R] - comb[b][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static void dfsR(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpR[a].add(new long[]{p, mask});
            return;
        }
        dfsR(ind + 1, a - 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind),
             p + (comb[a][R] - comb[a - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsR(ind + 1, a, b - 1, mask,
             p - (comb[b][R] - comb[b - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static int rev(int x, int y) {
        int z = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            if ((x & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                z ^= 1 << (y - 1 - i);
            }
        }
        return z;
    }

    static boolean ok(long x) {
        for (int i = 0; i < C + 1; i++) {
            if ((x & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'B') return false;
            } else {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'A') return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void check(long x, int t) {
        long tmp = 0;
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        int len = 2 * C + 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if ((x & (1L << i)) != 0) a++;
            else b++;
            if (a > 0 && b > 0) {
                for (int j = i; j < len; j++) {
                    if ((x & (1L << j)) != 0) {
                        if (S.charAt(S.length() - len + j) == 'B') return;
                    } else {
                        if (S.charAt(S.length() - len + j) == 'A') return;
                    }
                }
                int aa = 0, bb = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < S.length() - len + i; j++) {
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'A') aa++;
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'B') bb++;
                }
                if ((x & (1L << i)) != 0) {
                    tmp = comb[R - 1 - aa + b + R - 1 - bb][R - 1 - aa];
                } else {
                    tmp = comb[a + R - 1 - aa + R - 1 - bb][a + R - 1 - aa];
                }
                ans += t * tmp;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        try {
            init();
            dfsL(0, R - 1, R - 1, 0, 0);
            dfsR(0, R + C, R + C, 0, 0);
            
            long dif = INF;
            for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
                Collections.sort(dpL[i], (x, y) -> Long.compare(x[0], y[0]));
                Collections.sort(dpR[i], (x, y) -> Long.compare(y[0], x[0]));
                int ind = 0;
                for (long[] t : dpL[i]) {
                    while (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size() && t[0] + dpR[i].get(ind + 1)[0] >= 0) ind++;
                    dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t[0] + dpR[i].get(ind)[0]));
                    if (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size()) {
                        dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t[0] + dpR[i].get(ind + 1)[0]));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
                List<long[]> z = new ArrayList<>();
                for (long[] t : dpR[i]) {
                    if (ok(rev((int)t[1], C + 1))) {
                        z.add(t);
                    }
                }
                int ind = 0;
                int l = 0, r = -1;
                for (long[] t : dpL[i]) {
                    while (l < z.size() && t[0] + z.get(l)[0] > dif) l++;
                    while (r + 1 < z.size() && t[0] + z.get(r + 1)[0] >= -dif) r++;
                    if (l <= r) {
                        check(t[0] | ((long)rev((int)z.get(l)[1], C + 1) << (C + 1)), r - l + 1);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            System.out.println(ans);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
